~Fire Burst~.Effect:
Deal 1d10 Fire Damage to a Unit.
If it had already taken Fire Damage this Combat, its hit by another 1d10 Fire Damage.

{CriticalStrike} for each 10 rolled, apply a ~Combo~.

~Burning Breath~.Effect: All Units 3x3 meter area take 1d6 Fire Damage.
~Burning Breath~.Combo: If any affected Unit has a Combo, +50% total Damage (to all Units) and does not trigger the Cooldown.

~Searing Arrows~.Effect: Shoot 3 rays of fire (at one or more Units). Each does 1d10 Fire Damage.
~Searing Arrows~.Notes: You can roll them one by one, after they deal the Damage.

~Cinder Storm~.Effect: Each Unit in a 5x5 meter area centered on you takes 2d4 Fire Damage. Units exactly on the outer edge of the area are also Dazed or Blinded (your choice).

~Scorching Heat~.Effect: A Unit you can see takes 3d4 Fire Damage, then becomes Frail.

~Fire Ball~.Effect: All Units in 6x6x6 meter area take 6d8 Fire Damage.
~Fire Ball~.Notes: Cover is calculated from the center of the area.

~Blazetrail~.Effect: A Unit you can see gains propulsion by fire. It gains +3 Movement Speed and whenever it comes near a Unit, that Unit takes 1d4 Fire Damage.
~Blazetrail~.Upgrade: The Damage also happens the moment you cast this Spell, around the target Unit.
~Blazetrail~.Notes: The Damage can only happen once per Turn per Unit. The Damage source is you (for amplification effects).

~Ignition~.Effect:
Ignite a Unit you can see. At the end of each of your Turns, it takes 8 Fire Damage.
Its ignition ends if the Unit is Damaged by Cold, Shock or Acid or is splashed with water.

~Cauterize~.Effect:
Choose a Unit you can see. Deal 3d6 Fire Damage to it.
At the start of its Turn, Heal it for 5d6.
~Cauterize~.Combo: You can repeat this next Turn, without spending the Mana.

~Meteor~.Effect:
Conjure a 5x5x5 meter _meteor_ that falls from the sky onto an area, dealing 10d4 Fire Damage on impact.
At the start of your next Turns, the _meteor_ keeps rolling away from you up to 3 meters and dealing 5d4 Fire Damage to Units hit again.
The zone underneath the meteor is Hard Terrain.

~Armaggeddon~.Effect: Rain death of fire upon the entire battlefield. ALL Units on the battlefield take 21d6 Fire Damage.

~Lightning Chord~.Effect:
Create a lightning chord between you an a Unit.
At the end of your every Turn, if in range, deal 1d6 Shock Damage to it. Otherwise, the chord breaks.

{CriticalStrike} if you roll 6, apply a ~Combo~.
~Lightning Chord~.Upgrade: The chord is broken if you end your Turn more than 5 meters away from it.
~Lightning Chord~.Notes:
A Unit can only be affected by one of your Lightning Chords at a time.
You can have multiple Units chorded at a time.

~Charge Ward~.Effect:
An Ally you can see (or you) becomes surrounded in an electric aura.
They gain 1d6 Shielding. When it breaks, deal that much Shock Damage to all Units within 1 meter of the Ally.

~Electromagnetism~.Effect: ~Shock-~Slam a Unit 1d8 meters in any direction.
~Electromagnetism~.Upgrade: ~Shock-~Slam impact Damage is Shock for enemies, and the impact Heals allies instead of dealing Damage.
~Electromagnetism~.Notes: If both impact Units are allies, it heals them both.

~Chain Thunder~.Effect:
Strike a Unit for 3d6 Shock Damage.
The then lightning jumps to the closest _new_ Unit again and again, dealing 1 less d6 Damage each time, until no more dice are left.
~Chain Thunder~.Upgrade: For the new Damage, you can remove one of the d6's from the previous result, or reroll the Damage with 1 less d6.
~Chain Thunder~.Notes:
This lightning can't strike the same Unit twice per cast (so it only hits ^new^ Units that it hasn't hit). The jumping stops if there are no new Units to jump to.
If there's a tie for the closest Unit, you choose which Unit it hits.

~Ion Coil~.Effect:
Surround a Unit you can see in an electrical coil.
Whenever ^you^ Damage a Unit, the coil zaps the closest Unit within 2 meters of it for 1d4 Shock Damage.

~Conduit Vortex~.Effect:
Blast a Unit for 4d6 Shock Damage. For each die, Heal a Unit within 2 meters of it for 1 of the dice rolled, one die per Unit.

All dice that don't have a Unit to Heal go back into the main target, Damaging it again!
~Conduit Vortex~.Notes: Each die ^must^ go into a Unit if available, and can only go back into the main target if there are no other Units to go into.

~Overload~.Effect: Obliterate a Unit with a lightning that deals 1d12 Shock Damage for each Combo, Shielding, and  _active_ lighting or Shock Spell on either of you.
~Overload~.Notes: Effects like Lighting Chord cast on that target affect ^both^ of you, so it counts as 2 instances of an active lightning Spell.

~Ball Lightning~.Effect:
Conjure a ball lightning on an empty space, which zaps a Unit within 3 meters for 3d10 Shock Damage whenever it moves from place.
You are immune to the ball lighting's Damage.

~Elating Jolt~.Effect:
Choose a Unit you can see.
If your last cast Spell was shock-themed (e.g. from the Lightning Font), Heal them for 1d8 and they regain 1 Mana.
Otherwise it takes 1d6 Shock Damage and is Deafened.

~Current~.Effect:
You transform into a lightning current and bolt to a destination.
Each Unit you pass through takes 2d4 Damage.
~Current~.Upgrade: You can not bolt through if your body would touch a metallic obstacle or water.

~Electronova~.Effect:
All other Units within 5 meters of you take 10d6 Shock Damage, except for 0* Units you choose, which are instead Healed for 50% of that amount.

Whenever you cast this, increase the number of Units you can choose as exceptions by 1.

~Curse of the Thunder God~.Effect: Choose a Unit you can see and curse it to be struck by lightning every Turn (or 6 seconds) for 6d4 Shock Damage for up to 24 hours.

~Ice Shard~.Effect:
Throw an icicle at Unit, dealing Cold Damage equal to 1d4 + its Setback (or Initiative).
Deals +50% Damage if the target is under any Status Effect.

~Rime Shackles~.Effect:
Deal Cold Damage to a Unit equal to 1d6 + ^Its Instinct^.
Slow it and apply a ~Combo~ to it.

~Snowstorm~.Effect:
Choose a 4x4 meter area and a direction.
Each Enemy caught already effected by any Status Effect takes 1d4 Cold Damage.
Then each Unit is ~Cold-~Slammed 1d6 meters in that direction.

~Frostfall~.Effect:
Choose a Unit. It takes 1d10 Cold Damage, and each Unit within 2 meters of it takes Cold Damage equal to 200% of the rolled amount.
If there were no Units within 2 meters of it, the target is Double-Stunned instead.
~Frostfall~.Upgrade: When Stunning a flying target, it remains stuck in the air (levitating) for up to 6 seconds.

~Hypothermia~.Effect: Deal 1d10 Cold Damage to a Unit. Deal +1d10 for each Status Effect it was affected with this Combat.
~Hypothermia~.Notes: While you have this Ability, keep track of what Status Effects you affected certain Units with.

~Deep Freeze~.Effect: A Unit takes 4d6 Cold Damage and is Single-Stunned.
~Deep Freeze~.Downside: Only usable on Units that have taken Cold Damage this Combat.

~Creeping Cold~.Effect: Shoot a 3x6 gale line of frost. All Units caught gain +1 Setback (or +0.5 Initiative), then take Cold Damage equal to their Setback (or Initiative).

~Armor of Hrim~.Requirement: Level 7 and only works in Worthy Combat
~Armor of Hrim~.Effect:
A Unit you can see gains a _hrim_ armor that keeps growing.
Now and at the end of its Turns, it gains 1 Shielding that can block 1d4 Damage.
At the start of any other Unit's (or Unit group's) Turn, increase any still existing _hrim_ Shieldings' values on it by 1d4.
~Armor of Hrim~.Notes: For example, if you cast Armor of Hrim on a Unit, it gains 1d4 Shielding. Then, if another ally starts their Turn, increase that _hrim_ Shielding by 1d4. Note that you increase the Shielding's ^value^, not just add another Shielding!

~Iceberg Drop~.Effect:
Choose a 6x6x6 meter area.
Conjure a giant iceberg in the sky that you drop upon the area.
All Units hit are pushed to the closest available edge of the area and take 6d6 Cold or Smash Damage.
The iceberg remains in the area until it melts.

~Crystalize~.Effect:
Use when a Unit would take Damage.
Give it 3 Shieldings that can block 1d20 Damage each, and Double-Stun it.

~Absolute Zero~.Effect: Use when a Unit starts its Turn. It takes 4d4 Cold Damage and is _1d6_-Stunned.

~Whiteout~.Effect:
Conjure a fog of tiny ice specks in a 1x1x1 kilometer area, which keeps getting colder.
At the start of ^each^ Turn, all Units in the area take 1 Damage and that Unit becomes Slowed.
You can spend a 1 Action Point at the start of each of your Turns to maintain the effect.

~Magic Arrows~.Effect: Shoot 2 arcane arrows. Each does 1d4 Pulse Damage.
~Magic Arrows~.Combo: 1 more arcane arrow shoots from the target into any target within 5 meters of it.
~Magic Arrows~.Notes: When you cast this, decide the targets before rolling the dice. Roll the dice for each target at a time.

~North Star~.Effect: You conjure a magical star that always shoots North and deals 9d4 Pulse Damage to the first Unit hit.
~North Star~.Combo: The star explodes, dealing 50% of the total Damage to all other Units within 2 meters of the hit target.
~North Star~.Notes:
You can only shoot the star towards North - without an angle.
Ask the DM which way North is (if your Hero knows that).

~Magic Ward~.Requirement: Level 2, only usable in Worthy Combat
~Magic Ward~.Effect: Give an ally you can see one Shielding that can block 1d6 Damage.

~Longblade~.Effect:
Magically extend the weapon of a willing ally you can see (or yourself) to up to 3 meters.
Its Attacks with that weapon can have up to 3 meters range.

~Magic Arrow Barrage~.Effect:
Conjure floating arrows in a 3x3 area, up to 10 meters above ground.
At any point (for 0 Action Points or with a Reaction), you can release these arrows downward. All Enemies hit take 3d4 Pierce Damage.
~Magic Arrow Barrage~.Upgrade: At the start of your every Turn, if the barrage is not yet released, it increases by 1 meter in size in all directions and gains 1d4 Damage when it will be released (up to +3d4 and 9x9).
~Magic Arrow Barrage~.Notes:
E.g. every turn, it goes from 3x3 to 5x5, then 7x7, then 9x9, etc and deals from 2d6 Damage to 2d6 + 1d4, then 2d6 + 2d4, etc.
The arrows disappear as soon as they hit ground, or when dismissed (all at once) for free at any point, or after 1 minute of staying in the air.

~Arcane Prison~.Effect: Each Unit within 2 meters of you takes 2d4 Pulse Damage and becomes Dazed and Slowed.

~Ray of Annihilation~.Effect: Shoot a massive beam of pure arcane energy onto a Unit, dealing 11d6 Pulse Damage.

~Afterflash~.Effect: Choose a Unit. It takes 4d4 Shock Damage and teleport it up to 6 meters away.

~Mirror Clone~.Effect:
Summon a magical clone of an Allied Hero, with its current Health, Mana, Cooldowns, etc at this time.
You control it, it takes Turns like the Hero, but takes 500% Damage, deals only 10% Damage (at lest 1 per instance), and can't inflict Status Effects.
~Mirror Clone~.Notes: The clone counts as a Hero, and respects all Hero rules (e.g. monster Setback).
